title: CBLM 7 Study Guide: Maintain and Enhance Technical Competency
title_bn: CBLM 7 স্টাডি গাইড: নিজের technical competency ধরে রাখা ও বাড়ানো
intro_bn: এই গাইড CBLM 7-কে পাতার ক্রমে পড়ায়: আগে LO ও PC, তারপর Information sheet-এর চারটি অংশ, তারপর Job 1, Specification Sheet 1 আর Review of Competency।
প্রতিটি তথ্যের পাশে CBLM-এর পাতা নম্বর আছে; উদাহরণ, বাংলা ব্যাখ্যা আর memory tip শুধু শেখার সহায়ক।
মূল শিকল মনে রাখুন: Standard খুঁজুন → নিজেকে যাচাই করুন (gap) → Plan ও approval → Training → Competency প্রমাণ।
শেষে ৬টি Self Check, MCQ, matching, viva আর last-minute revision sheet দিয়ে নিজেকে যাচাই করুন।

topics.title_bn: TVET trainer-কে কেন দক্ষতা বাড়াতেই হবে

blocks.q: Why must a TVET trainer maintain and enhance technical competency?
blocks.q_bn: TVET trainer-কে কেন technical competency ধরে রাখতে ও বাড়াতে হয়?

answer.text: TVET is a dynamic industry. Trainers maintain and enhance technical competency to cope with change.

cites.quote:
Technical Vocational Education and Training
(TVET) is a dynamic industry.

TVET teachers/trainers also need to
maintain and enhance their technical competency
to cope up with this change.

blocks.tip: Keyword first: 'TVET is a dynamic industry'. Then: technology changes, industry demands updated skills.
blocks.tip_bn: উত্তর শুরু করুন 'dynamic industry' দিয়ে, তারপর technology আর industry demand।

claims.text: Technical skills of TVET trainers shall be both institution based and industry based.

cites.quote:
Technical Skills of TVET teachers/trainers shall be both Institution based and
Industry based.

claims.text: Strong linkage between industry and TVET institution is needed for industry based upgrading.

cites.quote:
Strong linkage between industry and TVET Institution is needed to deliver
industry based skills upgrading programs.

bn: দক্ষতা দুই জায়গা থেকে আসে: institution-এ আর industry-তে।
Industry-তে training দিতে হলে institution আর industry-র শক্ত linkage লাগে।

claims.text: Trainers undergo upgrading training at the premises of selected industrial establishments.

cites.quote:
TVET teachers/trainers will undergo Technical Skills upgrading training at the
premises of selected industrial establishment.

claims.text: Industry Skill Councils facilitate linkages and coordinate implementation of the training.

cites.quote: Industry Skill Councils will

facilitate linkages of training with industry and coordinate implementation of the
training program.

bn: যেমন: একজন electrician trainer নির্বাচিত কোনো কারখানার ভেতরেই upgrading training নেবেন।

in the library of the institution.

claims.text: The TVET Reform Project pilots in four sectors. Three occupations each make 12 sub sectors.

cites.quote:
Under the TVET Reform Project there are four sectors where the piloting will be
conducted.

There are three occupations or sub-sectors within these four
sectors which altogether make 12 occupational sub sectors.

bn: ৪ × ৩ = ১২: Agro-Food, IT, Leather, Transport — প্রতিটায় তিনটি পেশা (card-এর table দেখুন)।

claims.text: Standards exist up to level 3. In future there will be more, up to level 6.

cites.quote:
TVET Reform project has already developed Competency Standards
Document for each occupational sectors mentioned above up to level 3.

In
future there will be more Competency Standards Document on different trade
areas and sector up to level 6.

bn: এখন level 3 পর্যন্ত standard আছে; ভবিষ্যতে level 6 পর্যন্ত হবে।

topics.title_bn: Self assessment কী ও তার চার ধাপ

claims.text: After accessing the standard, the trainer plans self assessment. It shows skills and knowledge gaps.

cites.quote:
After accessing the relevant competency standard document at
desired level, now it is required for the TVET teacher/trainer to
plan his self assessment in respect to the competency
standards.

This self assessment will be helpful for the
teacher/trainer to identify his/her skills and/or knowledge gaps.

bn: Standard হাতে → নিজেকে যাচাই → gap খোঁজা → feedback থেকে development plan।

answer.text: Self assessment assesses own skills, knowledge and competencies against a predefined standard. It finds the gap to plan training.

cites.quote:
Self assessment is a way to assess someone's own skills, knowledge and
competencies in respect to some predefined standard to determine the
knowledge, skills and competencies gap to plan future training and up skilling
requirements.

example.en: An IT support trainer at a TSC ticks a BTEB checklist. He finds he cannot configure a network switch.
example.bn: Checklist মিলিয়ে নিজের দুর্বল জায়গা খুঁজে পাওয়াই self assessment।

claims.text: The four steps of Self-Assessment run from identifying own skills to identifying development needs.

cites.quote: The four steps of Self-Assessment
Identify own skills and knowledge relating to trade/occupation
Identify further skills, knowledge development needs

bn: চার ধাপ মনে রাখুন: Identify → Assess → Discuss → Identify (card-এর flow দেখুন)।

topics.title_bn: Underpinning skills ও knowledge; নিজের gap খোঁজা

answer.text: Underpinning means to support something from below like a foundation. It describes foundational knowledge or skills for a job.

cites.quote: Underpinning means to support something from below like a foundation.

It is
commonly used to describe any knowledge or skills that are foundational

claims.text: Example unit: "Use equipment for building and maintaining a garden". It has underpinning knowledge and skills.

cites.quote:
One of
the units of competency is "Use equipment for building and maintaining a
garden"
Unit of Competency (UoC) includes some skills and knowledge

bn: জানা (types of spades) = knowledge; করা (choosing the right spade) = skills — card-এর compare দেখুন।

claims.text: Skills gap: compare existing competency with required competency. Required skills are in each UoC.

cites.quote:
One can easily compare his
existence competency and required competency.

Required Underpinning
Skills can be found out with each Unit of Competency (UoC)

bn: যা লাগবে (UoC-তে লেখা) বিয়োগ যা আছে = skills gap।

claims.text: Knowledge gap: look for the Required Underpinning Knowledge in each UoC.

cites.quote:
Underpinning knowledge required for
such task can be found in each Unit of Competency (UoC).
can look for Required Underpinning Knowledge and proceed accordingly.

bn: Knowledge gap-ও একইভাবে: প্রতিটি UoC-এর Required Underpinning Knowledge দেখে মিলিয়ে নিন।

topics.title_bn: Learning outcome কী; CBLM 7-এ দুটি শর্ত

answer.text: Statements drawn from industry competency standards. They describe all skills the trainee should perform.

cites.quote:
Learning outcomes are statements which drawn from the industry competency
standers to clearly describe all the skills the trainee should be able to perform
as a result of the training.

blocks.tip: Add: all learning outcomes are derived from the elements of units of competency.
blocks.tip_bn: মনে রাখুন: learning outcomes আসে UoC-এর elements থেকে।

claims.text: After the overall training plan, identify learning outcomes. Describe them in precise detail.

cites.quote:
Once the overall training plan has been developed, the next step is to identify a
set of learning outcomes that will meet the aim.

The learning outcomes must be
described in much more precise detail

claims.text: All learning outcomes are derived from the elements of units of competency.

cites.quote:
all the learning
outcomes are derived from the elements of different unit of competencies.

bn: Learning outcome দিয়েই training session-এর তথ্য, skills আর activities plan হয়।

blocks.title: Criteria of appropriate learning outcomes (CBLM 7)

items.text: They must be observable. Can you see the progress of the trainee?

cites.quote:
They must be observable. Can you actually see or observe the
progress of the trainee?

items.text: They must be measurable. Can you measure the output or progress?

cites.quote:
They must be measurable. Can you measure the output or progress of
the trainee?

items_bn: Observable — trainee-এর অগ্রগতি চোখে দেখা যায় কি না।
Measurable — output বা অগ্রগতি মাপা যায় কি না।

claims.text: "Perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding-Position 5G, 6G" is observable and measurable.

cites.quote:
If the learning outcome is "Perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding-Position
5G, 6G", here one can easily observe the performance
so this learning outcome is observable.
Learning outcome is also measurable

bn: Welding চোখে দেখা যায় (observable), standard মেনেছে কি না মাপা যায় (measurable)।

claims.text: Appropriate learning outcomes need to meet two criteria.

cites.quote: Appropriate learning outcomes need to meet two criteria.

claims.text: Appropriate learning outcomes need to meet three criteria.

cites.quote: Appropriate learning outcomes need to meet three criteria.

blocks.text: CBLM 7 names two criteria. CBLM 9 adds a third: clear verbs. For a CBLM 7 question write observable and measurable; you may add clear verbs from CBLM 9.
blocks.bn: CBLM 7-এ শর্ত দুটি, CBLM 9-এ তিনটি (clear verbs)। CBLM 7-এর প্রশ্নে দুটি লিখুন; চাইলে তৃতীয়টি যোগ করুন।

Evidence is information gathered and matched against a unit of
competency/ies to provide proof that a person is competent.

cites.quote:
Evidence is information gathered and matched against a unit of

blocks.title: Sources of evidence (CBLM 7)

items.text: Products that have been produced or made by assessee

cites.quote: Products that have been produced or made by assessee

items.text: Processes that had been carried out by the assessee

cites.quote: Processes that had been carried out by the assessee

items.text: underpinning knowledge and skills demonstrate by the assessee

cites.quote: underpinning knowledge and skills demonstrate by the assessee

cites.quote: underlying attitudes exhibited by the assessee

items_bn: Products — assessee যা বানিয়েছেন।
Processes — assessee যেভাবে কাজটা করেছেন।
Underpinning knowledge and skills — যে জ্ঞান ও দক্ষতা দেখিয়েছেন।
Underlying attitudes — কাজে যে মনোভাব দেখা গেছে।

cites.quote: Work piece is to specification.
Sale of product is made.
Customer is satisfied.
Budget is achieved.
Correct procedures are followed
Safe work methods are used.
Required service is provided.
Correct sequence is followed
Equipment is correctly set-up.

rows.text: Work as a member of a team.

cites.quote: Work as a member of a team.

maintained.

blocks.text: Products are results (work piece, sale, satisfied customer, budget). Processes are how the work is done (procedures, safety, sequence, set-up, teamwork, communication).
blocks.bn: Product = কাজের ফল; Process = কাজটা কীভাবে করা হলো।

claims.text: The forms of evidence depend on the purpose of assessment and the performance outcomes.
